body:
## Pull request overview

This PR provides a comprehensive architecture evaluation and 12-month transformation roadmap for ObjectStack's protocol specifications. The evaluation analyzed 71 existing protocol files and proposes 22 new protocol specifications to enhance ObjectStack's readiness as a universal enterprise software kernel.

**Changes:**
- Documents a phased approach to defining missing critical protocol specifications (SQL drivers, encryption, compliance, multi-tenancy, GraphQL, caching, etc.)
- Clearly separates protocol definition work (in this repo) from implementation work (in separate repos)
- Provides detailed Zod schema examples for proposed protocols, ensuring consistency with the existing protocol-first architecture
- Establishes success metrics and a prioritized roadmap for protocol development

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 4 out of 4 changed files in this pull request and generated 13 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| TRANSFORMATION_PLAN_V2.md | 4-phase roadmap (Q1-Q4) outlining 22 new protocol files to be defined, with clear separation between protocol specs and implementations |
| TECHNICAL_RECOMMENDATIONS_V2.md | Detailed Zod schema examples for missing critical protocols (GraphQL, encryption, caching, security, etc.) with competitive analysis |
| IMPLEMENTATION_CHECKLIST.md | Two-part checklist separating protocol work (31 items) from implementation work (17 items) with priority levels |
| EVALUATION_SUMMARY.md | Navigation hub summarizing the evaluation, providing quick-start paths for different personas, and explaining the V2 scope clarification |
